description: Two safe malformed-plate recovery policy mutations. Each preserves guards against invalid iterators and instance storage.

mutants.test_filter: BBS 3MF skips a plate mapping for a resource without a build instance
mutants.description: Reject rather than skip an unbuilt resource plate row. The public load-success and valid-sibling contract must fail ordinarily without an invalid dereference.

mutants.test_filter: BBS 3MF drops a plate row without an instance id
mutants.description: Reject rather than tolerate an incomplete plate-instance row. Public load success with preserved valid siblings must fail through the ordinary load-success assertion.
